nodes.label: Musical Chairs native Solana — discovery specification
nodes.rationale: Discovery architecture and proposed native-SOL scope; explicitly not an approved execution specification.

nodes.label: Musical Chairs Native Solana Implementation Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Task roadmap whose implementation steps remain gated by policy acceptance, measurements, and separate launch authority.

nodes.label: Native SOL economic and lifecycle recommendation
nodes.rationale: Economic and allocation recommendation; explicitly not approved implementation or measured SVM proof.

nodes.label: Processing and randomness recovery recommendation
nodes.rationale: Availability and recovery recommendation with no claim of measured performance or runtime readiness.

nodes.label: Fresh native SOL launch scope
nodes.rationale: Fresh SOL pool, separate legacy withdrawals, ICP PP/Shenanigans, and no imported balances.

nodes.label: ICP-hosted existing GUI
nodes.rationale: Existing GUI and ICP asset hosting remain in scope while native financial authority moves to Solana.

nodes.label: Native Solana financial authority
nodes.rationale: Solana program and wallet signatures control native pooled SOL, payouts, claims, and receipts.

nodes.label: Separate legacy withdrawals
nodes.rationale: Legacy positions and reserves are not imported and remain a separately labeled rail.

nodes.label: ICP social services
nodes.rationale: PP, Shenanigans, profiles, chat, and referrals stay ICP-authoritative.

nodes.label: Optional finalized-event ICP mirror
nodes.rationale: Mirror can serve history and rewards but cannot authorize native payouts or choose winners.

nodes.label: Existing ICP Chain Fusion SOL rail
nodes.rationale: Current SOL game is Motoko Chain Fusion with ICP-held records and payout signing.

nodes.label: Anchor/Rust program stack
nodes.rationale: Recommended initial stack for account validation and IDL; Pinocchio remains measurement-dependent optimization.

nodes.label: Atomic account mutation and SOL movement
nodes.rationale: Solana transaction can combine state mutation and SOL movement atomically, while failed transactions can still incur fees.

nodes.label: PDA-based custody
nodes.rationale: Program-derived custody removes the need for an ordinary private pool key.

nodes.label: Source economic rules
nodes.rationale: Existing source is the preservation reference, but local source is not deployed-state proof.

nodes.label: Gross-base accrual
nodes.rationale: Position accrues on gross deposit while pot receives amount after Front-End Load.

nodes.label: 35/45/20 Backer toll split
nodes.rationale: Source allocation uses senior A, proportional remaining A, and equal open B slices.

nodes.label: Absent/capped tier folding
nodes.rationale: Missing tiers fold to the other tier; cap overshoot and absent senior handling preserve conservation.

nodes.label: Integer lamport accounting
nodes.rationale: Native target uses 1-lamport partitions, remainder carry, floor Q18 factors, and residue to seed.

nodes.label: Candidate native account map
nodes.rationale: Account names, seeds, and schemas are a candidate map until bounded allocation is proved.

nodes.label: Config account
nodes.rationale: Canonical authenticated configuration account for schema, roles, schedules, and allowed changes.

nodes.label: Pool and custody vault
nodes.rationale: Spendable pot and accounted partitions with protected rent excluded from spendable funds.

nodes.label: Position account
nodes.rationale: Owner, client nonce, plan, gross amount, timing, withdrawal, and round state.

nodes.label: User and UserRound accounts
nodes.rationale: Permanent A/B existence flags and current-round gross deposits/actual payouts; Backer claims excluded from game P/L.

nodes.label: Backer account
nodes.rationale: A/B amount, entitlement, credited-to-date, claimable balance, and cap invariants.

nodes.label: Dense Backer registry and allocation ticket
nodes.rationale: Program-owned active pages, frozen snapshots, bounded cursors, pending toll, and finalized watermark.

nodes.label: Round and candidate pages
nodes.rationale: Program-owned current-round state and complete promotion candidate representation.

nodes.label: Operations vault and reserve
nodes.rationale: Separate sponsor balance and locked owner/sponsor storage/provider reserves.

nodes.label: Candidate native instruction set
nodes.rationale: Initialization, position, payout, A funding, claims, bounded progress, round close, and narrow controls.

nodes.label: Owner-signed payout destination
nodes.rationale: Default owner wallet; alternate destination requires explicit owner signature and review.

nodes.label: Serialized permissionless allocation
nodes.rationale: One ticket per toll with complete Discover/Senior/Seal/Allocate/Prune/Commit lifecycle.

nodes.label: Narrow processing barrier
nodes.rationale: Normal deposits remain available during nonclosing allocation; Backer mutation and later payout are paused.

nodes.label: Captured bounded allocation work
nodes.rationale: Work is finite and linear in captured N; chunk size, compute, latency, and reserve costs require measurement.

nodes.label: Current-round participant registry
nodes.rationale: Current-round P/L and complete preferred/fallback candidate lists avoid historical scans.

nodes.label: Authenticated bound randomness request
nodes.rationale: One request bound to sealed list/close ID; provider lifecycle and authority remain unproved.

nodes.label: Close plus 600-second deadline
nodes.rationale: Deadline begins at accepted close and does not reset on retries or candidate work.

nodes.label: Permissionless expiry and terminal finalization
nodes.rationale: After deadline, public expiry and terminal skip/finalization restore progress without rerolls.

nodes.label: Strict owed greater than pot trigger
nodes.rationale: Only owed > pot is insolvent; equality remains solvent and healthy empty rounds cannot be timer-closed.

nodes.label: Physical custody conservation
nodes.rationale: Protected-rent custody equals disjoint pot, seed, funded claims, management, pending escrow, and classified dust.

nodes.label: u64/u128/U256 width contract
nodes.rationale: Cash partitions use u64, cumulative and entitlement values u128, and wide pro-rata sums fixed U256.

nodes.label: Owner versus sponsor rent contract
nodes.rationale: Owner pays personal/User/Position/UserRound/A rent; sponsor pays shared storage and automatic B.

nodes.label: Governance and admission guardian
nodes.rationale: 2-of-3/48h governance and separate immediate pause guardian; actual identities remain launch inputs.

nodes.label: Typed native GUI boundary
nodes.rationale: Existing screens remain; native reads/actions use typed service without mixing ICP principals and Solana keys.

nodes.label: ICP PP and desk scope boundary
nodes.rationale: PP and desk remain separate ICP rails; native PP and cross-chain desk rewrite are deferred.

nodes.label: Fresh launch without imports
nodes.rationale: Native pool starts fresh and legacy liabilities/reserves remain outside native accounting.

nodes.label: Gross-base integer economic oracle
nodes.rationale: Preserve source gross accrual while replacing float/truncation with checked integer formulas; not deployed-state proof.

nodes.label: Economic width contract
nodes.rationale: Checked u64/u128/U256 boundaries are proposed implementation constraints.

nodes.label: Native custody conservation identity
nodes.rationale: Protected-rent custody must reconcile to spendable partitions and pending liabilities at every phase.

nodes.label: Permanent User and Backer history flags
nodes.rationale: Existence and EEC history persist after active membership compaction.

nodes.label: Dense active Backer registry
nodes.rationale: Active membership uses append/swap-delete pages while preserving first-funding order and history.

nodes.label: Program-verified snapshot completeness
nodes.rationale: Registry version, pages, indices, PDA/slot checks, and cursors prove complete traversal.

nodes.label: Atomic payout and whole-toll ticket
nodes.rationale: Payout is final first; whole toll enters pending allocation and cannot be reclaimed by timeout.

nodes.label: Native Solana Backer allocation phases
nodes.rationale: Each phase has bounded work and a conservation invariant.

nodes.label: Constant commit and lazy credit materialization
nodes.rationale: Scalar global commit avoids unbounded finalization and prevents double funding.

nodes.label: Combined A+B Backer claim
nodes.rationale: Claim checks expected owner/series accounts and lowers funded balances only.

nodes.label: Allocation economics barrier
nodes.rationale: A funding, later payouts, and registry changes pause while claims/progress remain available.

nodes.label: Zero on-chain keeper reward
nodes.rationale: Sponsors/callers pay network fees externally; reserve shared storage/provider/B costs separately.

nodes.label: Reusable prefunded rent pages
nodes.rationale: Temporary pages are reusable only after terminal obligations and persistent history are safe.

nodes.label: Linear work and capacity measurement
nodes.rationale: O(active Backers) work, latency, fee, and griefing envelope require benchmarks; no hidden cap.

nodes.label: Current-round P/L participant registry
nodes.rationale: UserRound records aggregate all game deposits and actual payouts, excluding Backer claims.

nodes.label: Preferred and fallback candidates
nodes.rationale: Preferred losers have positive loss and no ever-created A/B; fallback is all net losers.

nodes.label: Domain-bound randomness seed
nodes.rationale: Seed binds cluster/program/round/close/list digest and selected set.

nodes.label: Bounded 64-sample ordinal mapping
nodes.rationale: Same output and counters 0–63 avoid modulo bias without fresh draws.

nodes.label: Native Solana round closing and expiry
nodes.rationale: One close plus 600 seconds, public no-promotion expiry, and no fresh seed.

nodes.label: Provider lifecycle unproved
nodes.rationale: ORAO is a candidate; ownership, retention, fees, capture, and live identity require proof.

nodes.label: Implementation proof list
nodes.rationale: Exact oracle, bounded traversal, conservation, replay, provider, and GUI proofs remain ahead.

nodes.label: Processing permission matrix
nodes.rationale: Deposits/claims/progress availability differs between ordinary allocation, closing, and admission pause.

nodes.label: Captured work units
nodes.rationale: Reserve three row visits per captured Backer plus constants/pages; do not guess chunk count.

nodes.label: One-row progress fallback
nodes.rationale: Eight rows is an initial candidate; one-row permissionless progress must remain available.

nodes.label: Separate sponsor storage reserve
nodes.rationale: Sponsor reserve covers shared storage/provider/automatic B; optional owner contribution defaults zero.

nodes.label: No prepaid keeper reward
nodes.rationale: First release does not include on-chain keeper rewards or prepaid network fee subsidy.

nodes.label: No timeout cash abort
nodes.rationale: Operational defects preserve ticket/claims and require reviewed repair rather than unlocking incomplete cash.

nodes.label: Immutable close deadline state
nodes.rationale: Close stores time, deadline, phase identity, and policy snapshot once.

nodes.label: Canonical terminal promotion states
nodes.rationale: PromotionApplied or PromotionSkipped with Deadline, NoCandidates, or EntropyExhausted.

nodes.label: Capture and expiry predicates
nodes.rationale: Capture at Clock <= deadline; expiry only at Clock > deadline without timely capture.

nodes.label: Candidate-only cleanup
nodes.rationale: Abandoned candidate pages can be cleaned; financial allocations and claims cannot be deleted.

nodes.label: Exactly-once seed carry finalization
nodes.rationale: Full seed carries only after cash commit and terminal promotion; finalization is permissionless.

nodes.label: Selective withholding risk
nodes.rationale: No-reroll bounds bias but provider censorship/withholding can still deny promotion.

nodes.label: Recovery acceptance scenarios
nodes.rationale: Tests cover arbitrary interruption, replacement payer, deadline edges, stale callbacks, and conservation.

nodes.label: Native Solana implementation dependencies
nodes.rationale: Economic/oracle acceptance precedes bounded core, GUI, ICP integration, verification, and separately authorized launch.

nodes.label: Policy before production implementation
nodes.rationale: D1/D2 confirmed; D3–D9 recommended defaults do not imply acceptance.

nodes.label: Native implementation global constraints
nodes.rationale: Keep ICP hosting, native authority, source economics, fresh pool, no deploy/funding/signing, and branch isolation.

nodes.label: Task 2 bounded Backer math
nodes.rationale: Prove exact integer oracle, phases, conservation, lazy credit, and account limits before core implementation.

nodes.label: Task 3 bounded round closure
nodes.rationale: Prove candidate completeness, provider interface, deadline predicates, no reroll, and strict owed>pot.

nodes.label: Task 4 native core
nodes.rationale: Implement reviewed account layouts/IDL only after tasks 1–3 contracts are frozen.

nodes.label: Pilot N100/M100 measurements
nodes.rationale: Measure actual signatures, cleanup, packet/chunk choices, and ICP threshold cost; replace eight-row assumptions.

nodes.label: Task 5 preserved GUI
nodes.rationale: Connect wallet-signed native transactions and direct reads while preserving recognizable screens.

nodes.label: Task 6 ICP history and PP
nodes.rationale: Use finalized events, two-RPC observation, durable outbox, and separate desk rail.

nodes.label: Task 7 acceptance and reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Require receipts, conservation, finality, authority, outage, and artifact/IDL alignment evidence.

nodes.label: Task 8 separately authorized launch
nodes.rationale: Deployment, funding, authority, frontend serving, and live lifecycle require later explicit authorization.

nodes.label: Reprice exact launch costs
nodes.rationale: Reprice compiled bytes, storage/cleanup/retention, provider/config, fee/signature counts, SOL and cycles before funding.

nodes.label: No deployment evidence in discovery
nodes.rationale: Source, tests, CI, merge, deploy, funding, finality, and displayed balances remain distinct evidence.

nodes.label: ICP keeper authority boundary
nodes.rationale: Any ICP keeper has capped fee-only keys and no user/pool/governance/withdrawal authority.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph maintenance
nodes.rationale: Semantic and structural extraction stay separate; graph navigation does not replace financial tests or deployment proof.

nodes.label: Legacy ponzi_math_sol main.mo
nodes.rationale: Cited legacy Motoko financial source for records, addresses, observers, payouts, formulas, and desk behavior.

nodes.rationale: Cited legacy promotion eligibility helper.

nodes.rationale: Document-root navigation preserves the source status; its child concepts distinguish confirmed choices, recommendations and unmeasured work.

nodes.label: Musical Chairs — repo notes for Claude
nodes.rationale: Document-root navigation preserves the source status; its child concepts distinguish confirmed choices, recommendations and unmeasured work.

nodes.label: Native SOL fresh launch and legacy separation
nodes.rationale: Recorded user scope fixes a fresh native SOL pool, separately withdrawable legacy positions, and existing ICP-hosted GUI/PP rails.

nodes.label: No runtime result or mainnet authorization
nodes.rationale: Defaults are policy recommendations and do not select live identities or authorize capital, signers, endpoints, or mainnet configuration.

nodes.label: Native Solana pilot scale and reserve recommendation
nodes.rationale: Approximately 100 active Backers, 1,000 payouts, and 10 closes monthly support a conditional 12 SOL startup and 0.5–1.5 SOL monthly sponsor planning range; cycles are separate.

nodes.label: Native SOL only asset boundary
nodes.rationale: wSOL, stablecoins, bridges, imported positions, liquidity, and initial game reserves are excluded while non-game rent/storage/provider/operations reserves remain separate.

nodes.label: Lamport integer accounting contract
nodes.rationale: Use lamport floors and explicit u64/u128/U256 roles, with funded dust remaining claimable.

nodes.label: Fee payer does not confer financial authority
nodes.rationale: Owner remains financial authority and first-release personal rent payer; sponsors pay shared storage without gaining authority.

nodes.label: Native Solana governance
nodes.rationale: Squads v4 governance is proposed as independent 2-of-3 with a 172800-second timelock and Vault ownership of upgrades, config, provider client, and management rotation.

nodes.label: Admission guardian
nodes.rationale: A separate immediate 2-of-3 guardian may pause admissions only; it cannot write financial, round, ticket, or provider state.

nodes.label: Future-round provider changes only
nodes.rationale: Stored close tuples remain immutable and requests check registered client owner/state/config; active rebind and alternate callback candidates are excluded.

nodes.label: Bounded allocation work units
nodes.rationale: The proposed U_alloc(N)=3N+C_alloc+P_alloc(N) model and page/sample phases require measurement; constants are deliberately not fabricated.

nodes.label: Zero first-release keeper reward
nodes.rationale: Sponsor-run processes pay their own fees and any payer can progress; paid per-unit incentives are optional future work.

nodes.label: Protected on-chain reserve
nodes.rationale: Storage/page rent, provider request fee and rent cap, possible automatic B account, and program-owned close costs must be segregated before mutation and cannot be withdrawn.

nodes.label: Immutable close plus 600-second oracle deadline
nodes.rationale: One close deadline supports timely capture or public expiry with no reroll; no wall-clock reopening guarantee is made.

nodes.label: ORAO registered-client direct capture
nodes.rationale: The proposed first adapter uses ORAO registered-client requests, pins tuple/seed/marker, and treats request-level callback as optional capture-only behavior.

nodes.label: Native Solana keeper placement
nodes.rationale: External fee-only primary plus ICP monitor/emergency backup is preferred pending cost and latency review; alerts are operational policy, not a lease or admin resume credential.

nodes.label: Native Solana resource benchmarks
nodes.rationale: N, allocation, row-chunk, churn, dust, outage, CU, rent, latency, and sponsor-depletion cases are measurements to run, not capacity caps.

nodes.label: Operations funding and withdrawal boundary
nodes.rationale: Explicit fund_operations contributions are free sponsor balance; only the configured recipient may withdraw bounded free balance, while plain transfers remain unallocated excess.

nodes.label: Owner signer and rent-payer contract
nodes.rationale: Owner wallet remains financial authority; personal records require owner rent in first release, while shared and automatic B storage use reserved operations funds.

nodes.label: Native client and PP bridge defaults
nodes.rationale: Keep existing React/Vite wallet-adapter/web3.js v1 GUI, use legacy/v0 baseline, and require authenticated dual-RPC finalized observation with durable PP outbox semantics.

nodes.label: Native Solana ICP PP outbox
nodes.rationale: Write-ahead outbox legs have immutable recipients, amounts, memo hashes and retry states; unknown outcomes require history reconciliation and never blind reminting.

nodes.label: D1/D2 confirmed; D3–D9 recommended
nodes.rationale: Pilot scale and initial scope are confirmed, while economics, reserve, governance, PP trust, and keeper-host choices remain recommendations or measurements.

nodes.label: Native Solana pre-build policy, model-probe, and launch status
nodes.rationale: Recommended assumptions may be tested by a bounded economic-model/provider/resource probe; accepted policy belongs in the readable economic/parity contract, measured implementation proofs remain distinct, and voters, authorities, endpoints, funded reserves, and deployment permission are launch-only inputs.

nodes.label: Pilot workload scenario
nodes.rationale: Rob selected approximately 100 active Backers, 1000 payouts, and 10 closes monthly; row count, participants, and keeper signatures are calculation assumptions.

nodes.label: ICP keeper hosting option
nodes.rationale: ICP can host timers, threshold signing, RPC submission, history, outboxes, and monitoring, but native custody and payout rules remain on Solana.

nodes.label: SOL startup and monthly envelope
nodes.rationale: 12 SOL startup and 0.5–1.5 SOL monthly are conditional planning ranges excluding player costs, ICP cycles, subscriptions, development, audit, and liquidity.

nodes.label: Solana rent exemption curve
nodes.rationale: Observed quotes support R(bytes)=5080×(bytes+128) lamports; actual schemas must be re-queried before deployment.

nodes.label: ORAO Callback configured request fee
nodes.rationale: Finalized-slot validation reported 300000 lamports (0.0003 SOL) configured request fee and three fulfillment authorities implying three required responses under the stated quorum rule; this is not permanent liveness proof.

nodes.label: Squads ProgramConfig creation fee
nodes.rationale: Observed ProgramConfig creation fee was zero, while account rent and proposal/transaction fees still apply.

nodes.label: Loader deployment rent formula
nodes.rationale: Planning uses R(H+45)+R(B+37)+R(36) for conservative code plus buffer, with retained code R(H+45)+R(36); H and B require measured binaries and pinned CLI behavior.

nodes.label: Shared storage reserve estimate
nodes.rationale: For N=M=100, assumed layouts give roughly 0.0553 SOL global/registry rent, 0.2659 SOL reusable workset, and 0.3212 SOL shared peak before provider/client, receipts, cleanup overlap, and schema slack.

nodes.label: ORAO request and client rent lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Published SDK sizes are Client 123 bytes, pending request 759, fulfilled request 147; fulfillment returns 0.00310896 SOL excess request rent to Client while fee is consumed, and failed requests may retain pending allocation.

nodes.label: Squads record rent estimate
nodes.rationale: Two three-member records are estimated at 0.00364744 SOL rent and a three-member proposal at 0.00246888 SOL, with dynamic transaction storage and some terminal reclaimability.

nodes.label: Monthly keeper transaction model
nodes.rationale: K=P×(3×ceil(N/b)+3)+C×(ceil(M/b)+4) gives 42170 monthly transactions at the pilot b=8 scenario; this assumes phase packing and is not throughput proof.

nodes.label: Native Solana operating budget
nodes.rationale: 0.5–1.5 SOL/month is a replenishment range for modeled priorities, not protection against unlimited congestion, growth, cleanup, or griefing.

nodes.label: ICP threshold-signing cycle scenario
nodes.rationale: The document records 26153846153 cycles per key_1 signature and an illustrative dated XDR/USD conversion; USD must be repriced at funding time.

nodes.label: External worker VM estimate
nodes.rationale: A small external worker is estimated at 6–12 USD/month compute only; RPC, archive, monitoring, backup, and security costs remain unquoted.

nodes.label: Runtime sizing remains unproved
nodes.rationale: Actual binary, account layouts, packing, latency, provider compatibility, governance and fee reserves must be replanned before deployment; no funding or deployment is authorized.

nodes.label: Discovery-only scope
nodes.rationale: The discovery pass performed no product edits, builds, tests, deployments, chain transactions, financial actions, or production-state proof.

nodes.label: D1/D2 native SOL scope answers
nodes.rationale: Fresh native SOL, separately withdrawable legacy positions, SOL game first, and ICP PP/Shenanigans remain fixed; imports and native PP migration are excluded.

nodes.label: Claim-triggered close and 600-second recovery deadline
nodes.rationale: One close plus a 600-second promotion deadline allows public expiry and no-promotion reset while preserving protected cash processing; provider availability remains unproved.

nodes.label: Exact ORAO Callback manifest review
nodes.rationale: The published Callback manifest was checked, with registered-client and direct capture retained as recommendations; compatibility and deployment remain unproved.

nodes.label: ICP placement and budget investigation
nodes.rationale: The budget pass records rough provider/governance/resource counts and public snapshots while explicitly excluding implementation, deployment, signing, sending, funding, and current-user-canister queries.

nodes.label: External provider review boundary
nodes.rationale: Cheaper native Luna workers and local persona were used; private repository content was not sent to external Claude and no external review ran.

nodes.label: Graph-first worker workflow
nodes.rationale: Workers query the existing graph first, apply the persona, inspect source read-only, and return handoffs while the coordinator distinguishes historical proposals from current implementation.

nodes.label: Native program authority boundary
nodes.rationale: Native Solana controls financial state and SOL; ICP mirrors finalized history only, and caller-supplied subsets cannot establish complete Backer allocation or selection.

nodes.label: Finalized chain truth for native rail
nodes.rationale: Native chain finality replaces canister credit as financial truth; optional mirroring follows finality and cannot authorize balances or block payout.

nodes.label: Discovery verification limits
nodes.rationale: The receipt lists read-only graph/source/document review while explicitly stating no executable model, current-canister queries, RPC balance audit, frontend proof, validator, devnet transaction, or independent implementation audit.

nodes.label: Solana Foundation skill refresh receipt
nodes.rationale: The existing Foundation skill was refreshed at pinned public commit 491a19a4; 33 files matched, symlink and backup were preserved, and no product/dependency/MCP changes occurred.

nodes.label: Skill maintenance is not an implementation gate
nodes.rationale: Upstream guidance is a reviewed reference; it does not authorize frontend overhaul, automatic dependency migration, or block requested design work.

nodes.label: No private repository content to external provider
nodes.rationale: Public-source comparison and local entrypoint inspection were used without sending private repository content to another provider.

nodes.label: Existing root knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: The root graph is a large historical repository graph at graphify-out/graph.json; coverage outside this refresh is historical and not reverified at the current branch.

nodes.label: Scoped semantic refresh
nodes.rationale: Native specification, plan, economics, recovery, defaults, budget, discovery, skill assessment, workflow, and CLAUDE are refreshed with SHA256/line anchors; only D1/D2 and pilot scale are confirmed.

nodes.label: Coordinator graph merge responsibility
nodes.rationale: The coordinator preserves the root graph and merges scoped fragments, keeping generated graphify output ignored and maintaining baseline/freshness distinctions.

nodes.label: Native Solana graph maintenance handoff
nodes.rationale: Query first, use exact source identities, semantically extract changed documents, preserve edge direction/confidence/hyperedges, and never fabricate cross-language calls.

nodes.label: Scoped graph query and evidence checks
nodes.rationale: Queries must cover financial authority/ICP boundaries, Backer allocation, close/randomness expiry, operations cost, dependencies, hashes, stale coverage, and evidence limits.

nodes.label: Repository-scope graph preservation
nodes.rationale: Subfolder rebuilds must not overwrite the root graph or advance the whole manifest when only a subset was semantically extracted.

nodes.label: Solana concept explanation rule
nodes.rationale: Explain programs/data accounts, PDAs, account and compute bounds, rent, CPI, oracle fulfillment, and finality against ICP/EVM comparisons while separating hypotheses from measurements.

nodes.label: Unmeasured keeper budget scenario
nodes.rationale: The eight-row/42170-transaction monthly figure is a scenario, not inherent Solana overhead or an accepted capacity cap; claim-triggered rounds and permissionless continuation remain the model.

nodes.label: CLAUDE graphify maintenance rules
nodes.rationale: Query existing graph first; after native spec/plan/economic/recovery changes, semantically extract changed documents and merge while preserving unrelated nodes, direction, hyperedges, hashes, and scoped freshness.

nodes.label: CLAUDE native Solana explanation guidance
nodes.rationale: Tie Solana concepts to ICP/EVM comparisons and concrete behavior, covering accounts, PDAs, transaction bounds, rent, CPI, randomness, and finality while distinguishing proposed and tested facts.
